foodPerResidentPerDay.description: Food units one resident eats per game day (provisional).

shortageSlowdownPermille.description: Work speed while the settlement is out of food, in thousandths (provisional).

daysWithoutFoodUntilFirstLeaves.description: Days without food after which the first resident leaves (provisional).

leaveIntervalDays.description: Days between two leaving residents while food is still missing (provisional).

warnDaysBeforeEmpty.description: Days of food left at which the player is warned (provisional).

taxPerResidentPerDay.description: Gold per resident per day; multiplied by the settlement center level in code (provisional).

residentStepTicks.description: Ticks a resident needs to cross one tile walking (provisional).

arrivalHour.description: Hour of the day when a newcomer may arrive (provisional).

arrivalFreeSlotPoints.description: Arrival chance points per free house place (provisional).

arrivalFoodPoints.description: Arrival chance points when food lasts arrivalFoodDays for everyone including the newcomer (provisional).

arrivalFoodDays.description: Days of food needed for the food points (provisional).

arrivalNoRaidPoints.description: Arrival chance points when there was no raid for arrivalNoRaidDays (provisional).

arrivalNoRaidDays.description: Raid-free days needed for the no-raid points (provisional).

arrivalFamePointsDivisor.description: Fame is divided by this to get arrival chance points (provisional).

arrivalEraPoints.description: Arrival chance points per era, in era order; one entry per era, each 0..100 (provisional).

haulCapacity.description: Items a carrier moves in one trip (provisional).

storageStacksPerItem.description: Stacks of one item a storage holds at most, so that one good cannot fill it (provisional).

jobRetryCooldownTicks.description: Ticks a failed job stays banned for the resident, at least 1 so a ban outlives the tick it was given in (provisional).

thinkIntervalTicks.description: Ticks between two decisions of an idle resident (provisional).

idleThinkMaxIntervalTicks.description: Longest wait between two looks of a resident that keeps finding no work; the wait doubles from thinkIntervalTicks after every look that found nothing (provisional).

skillSpeedPermillePerPoint.description: Work speed gain per skill point, in thousandths (provisional).

initialSkillMax.description: A newcomer starts with each skill between 0 and this value (provisional).

jobSearchMarginTiles.description: Tiles beyond the territory border where residents still look for resource nodes to work (provisional).

autoAssignPattern.description: Profession ids handed to newcomers in turn, wrapping around. Ordinary professions only; at least one.
